title: Shulchan Arukh Yoreh Deah — Wikisource English 150 and 160 (partial)

changes: Selected paragraphs from two source revisions, removed page navigation and interleaved Hebrew, combined adjacent English paragraphs, and escaped text for the reader. Adapted text remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
scope: Partial translations of 150:1–3 and 160:1 only. The English omits some Rema material, notably a qualification in 150:3 and part of 160:1; it is not an independent full translation or scholarly proofreading.
